Command: "￼"
Return a dictionary with: - "intent": exactly one of: add, recommend, unknown - "title": for add — the title the user wants to add, cleaned of command words (string); otherwise empty - "mood": for recommend — the mood or wish in a few English words, e.g. "light comedy", "something tense" (string); empty if none - "types": for recommend — list of requested types from: movie, tv_show, animation, animated_series, anime, documentary; empty list if not specified
